2558-5226-6277--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-5226-6277--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
On Wings of Gold triggers. Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a 1/1 creature token. The +1/+1 bonus from On Wings of Gold is countered by the -1/-1 from the templated card
Repeat from step 2.

4279-5687-7918--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5687-7918--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent, Skittering Precursor and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3602-6495--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one of the two persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3602-6495--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a persist creature that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Bhaal trigger.
Resolve the Bhaal trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the remaining persist creature.
Resolve the sacrificed creature's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Repeat.
3602-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2738-4871-5256-6887.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, The Skullspore Nexus, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4682-4772-5140-7824.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
4682-4772-5140-7824.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Doubling Season and Bard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
4682-4772-5140-7824.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

643-3951-5703-7824.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
643-3951-5703-7824.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

4038-5963-7704.description:
Activate Marvin using Doc Samson's ability by tapping it, adding an amount of mana equal to Marvin's power.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Marvin.
Repeat.

2919-6752-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-6752-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2508-5540-7512.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause an artifact, creature, or enchantment to enter the battlefield.
An opponent controls an artifact.
If you are going to have a nonartifact creature or enchantment enter the battlefield, an opponent must also control either a creature or enchantment respectively.
2508-5540-7512.description:
Cause an artifact, creature or enchantment to enter the battlefield.
Confusion in the Ranks triggers, exchanging control of the permanent that entered with an opponent for another permanent of the same type.
Zidane triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Confusion in the Ranks triggers, exchanging control of the Treasure with an opponent for another artifact.
Repeat from step 3.
2508-5540-7512.notes: Collector Ouphe prevents the opponents from sacrificing the Treasures for mana. Without it, your opponents can sacrifice the Treasures and stop you (eventually) from exchanging control of artifacts.

1292-3117-5078-7444.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-4460-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

57-4235-4846-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4235-4846-7297.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1256-1270-5477-7297.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

851-1409-6463.description:
Activate Meticulous Artisan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Meticulous Artisan enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Meticulous Artisan.
Resolve the Meticulous Artisan trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

4875-5310-6798-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
4875-5310-6798-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1579-4050-6972--112.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Visionary Augmenter.
When Visionary Augmenter dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Visionary Augmenter enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1579-4050-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Visionary Augmenter's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

7-4484-4871-5643-5686.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
7-4484-4871-5643-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-4484-4871-5643-5686.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
7-4484-4871-5643-5686.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

280-803-1399-1606.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

790-1218-2152.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
790-1218-2152.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Fate Unraveler infect until end of turn.
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Fate Unraveler triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

372-2897-4681.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Gigantoplasm.
372-2897-4681.description:
Cast Gigantoplasm by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Gigantoplasm's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Gigantoplasm leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Gigantoplasm into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Gigantoplasm from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

81-3812-6287.notablePrerequisites:
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness and has power 6 or greater.
Simic Ragworm and Kami of Whispered Hopes are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
81-3812-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Simic Ragworm.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2351-4081-4639.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Mothdust Changeling by tapping a blue creature you control except Unctus.
The creature triggers, causing you to loot.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Mothdust Changeling ability.
Repeat.

428-1694-3908-5541.notablePrerequisites:
Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Spark Double on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
428-1694-3908-5541.description:
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Spark Double.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Spark Double triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

813-1987-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with MV<=1 that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it

4050-5660-5662--35.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with MV<=1 if it doesn't have {X} in its mana cost, or {1} available otherwise.
4050-5660-5662--35.description:
Cast the creature with MV<=1 by paying its mana cost if it doesn't have {X} in its mana cost, or by paying {1} otherwise, causing the creature to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, Reyhan triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

500-3617-4867.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Cormela and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one Cormela token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the original Cormela and the token Cormela die, their abilities trigger, returning Time Walk and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1418-1467-2104-3634.notablePrerequisites: You haven't copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
1418-1467-2104-3634.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, copying Temporal Manipulation.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Temporal Manipulation to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

678-1789-2034-5130.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
678-1789-2034-5130.description:
Cast Realm-Scorcher Hellkite by paying {4}{R}{R} and sacrificing an additional artifact, enchantment or token.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it and Lathliss triggers.
Resolve the Realm-Scorcher Hellkite trigger, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Realm-Scorcher Hellkite, adding {C}{C}.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

579-4474-4824.notablePrerequisites:
Soliton does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Soliton.
579-4474-4824.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

914-2178-2292-3379.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
Thornbite Staff attached to Adun.
Adun does not have summoning sickness.
914-2178-2292-3379.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{R}{R}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Adun triggers, untapping Adun.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Adun by paying {B}{R}{G} and tapping it, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

406-4820-4869.notablePrerequisites:
An additional card in hand.
The number of cards in library is greater than each opponent's life total.
Tandem Lookout paired with Glint-Horn Buccaneer.
406-4820-4869.description:
Activate Cephalid Inkshrouder by discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Tandem Lookout triggers for each opponent dealt damage.
Resolve one trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Holding priority, repeat.
Repeat.
